title: Doubly efficient PIR with quasilinear server preprocessing
formal: Can single-server private information retrieval achieve \(N\operatorname{polylog}N\) server preprocessing time and storage together with polylogarithmic online query time and communication under Ring LWE, with only small client state?
definitions: Definitions and model details remain incomplete. Separate security-parameter factors from \(N\), specify client state and query costs, and require server-only preprocessing independent of a client.

import_provenance.original_title: Doubly efficient PIR with quasilinear server preprocessing
import_provenance.original_statement: Can single-server private information retrieval achieve N·polylog N server preprocessing time and storage together with polylog N online query time and communication under standard assumptions such as Ring LWE? The server preprocesses the public N-bit database by itself, and clients retain only poly(λ,log N) state.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial tightening of their N^{1+ε} preprocessing/storage guarantee for every fixed ε>0; their polylogarithmic online query complexity is already achieved. Client-specific preprocessing or extra noncolluding servers changes the problem.
